scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability
other_conditions: Applicant must have represented a district, the state of Odisha, or an Odisha university in sports & games.
Applicant must satisfy the eligibility criteria laid down by SAI/NSNIS for the specific coaching courses.
BPL applicants will be given priority over non‑BPL applicants, and selection priority is based on the applicant’s sporting achievements.
Beneficiaries must render two years of service in the Sports & Youth Services Department if required by the department.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 100% of the course fee plus a travel allowance for BPL sportspersons and 75% of the fee plus a travel allowance for non‑BPL sportspersons enrolling in SAI/NSNIS coaching courses.
documents_required: Selection letter from SAI/NSNIS (or website print‑out)
